summary: Retest of L02 LN-022 after the iteration_210 fixes. All three iteration_210 gaps are now fixed. (1) The UI 'Ajukan Harga Khusus' form creates an SO pending special_price entry with alloc_sig. (2) /price-approvals approve/reject now routes through decide_approval. (3) The line badge shows 'Harga khusus'. Regression: 17/17 pass across test_l02_ln022_special_price (5), test_l02_ln022_ln021_extra (4), test_l09_ln093_ln090 and test_l08_ln081_journey. New suite test_l02_ln022_form_path_retest.py: 5/6 pass. It covers the form path as salesadmin, supersede of the SO entry and the pra doc, PATCH 409, approving a superseded pra -> 409, approve via /price-approvals (price, price_source and special_price_id written, SO entry approved), reject mirror, SoD 403 on /price-approvals, stale qty -> 409 'ajukan ulang' with no saga_lock and a stable repeat, and 3 concurrent submits (2x200 + 1x409 SAGA_IN_PROGRESS; no lost entries; exactly 1 pending entry and 1 pending pra; the losing draft stays draft). FAIL: SoD bypass through the SO panel. UI E2E (sales@ requester, manager approver) passed. Request 18000, then request 17000: the first entry shows 'Digantikan pengajuan baru' and the pra doc is superseded. Manager so-appr-approve: line Rp 17.000/yard with the 'Harga khusus' badge, totals recomputed, SO auto-approved. Pusat Persetujuan > Pengajuan Harga Khusus: approving the valid pra gave 'Disetujui'; approving the stale pra showed a banner 'Alokasi roll/qty ... mengajukan ulang' and it stayed Menunggu.

critical.issue: SoD bypass. A manager who requested a special price (via the form or request-special-price) can approve their own entry from the SO panel (returns 200). The same action via /price-approvals/{id}/approve correctly returns 403. decide_approval never calls matrix.sod_blocked for special_price entries (it could check entry.requested_by_id, or the pra doc). Reproduced by test_sod_own_request_so_panel.

minor.issue: Admin can delete a pending SO-bound pra (200). The SO pending_approvals entry stays 'pending' with a dangling ref_id, so the SO is blocked from auto-approve. Approving it later would write special_price_id pointing to a deleted doc. It should return 409 for _so_bound pending/approved docs, or cascade to mark the SO entry rejected or superseded.

When a pra is decided through the SO path, only decided_by and decided_by_id are set. approved_by and approved_by_name are never set, so PriceApprovalCard (which reads approved_by_name) shows no 'Disetujui: <name>' on approved SO-bound cards.

The loser of a race gets 409 SAGA_IN_PROGRESS with a generic message ('sedang/pernah berjalan'). The custom detail 'Pesanan sedang diproses pengguna lain. Coba lagi.' passed to _saga.claim is not surfaced. The behaviour is correct; only the wording is affected.

Evidence uploaded through SpecialPriceRequestForm is stored on price_approvals.attachments. The SO entry has evidence=[], so the SO approvals panel shows 'Unggah Bukti' and no evidence link, and an approver in the SO panel cannot see the proof. It should be mirrored or linked.

_special_price_target (alloc_sig check) runs before _saga.claim, leaving a small window between check and write. There is also no try/finally after the claim, so an exception mid-decide leaves saga_lock behind.

ui_bugs.issue: The 'Ajukan Harga Khusus' toggle is hidden for the sales_admin role (isSales = role==='sales' only, isApprover = admin/manager). The backend allows it (order.update), and the stale-409 message tells 'Admin Sales' to re-request. salesadmin@ sees the panel but has no request button.

integration_issues.flow: Pusat Persetujuan > Pengajuan Harga Khusus card for an SO-bound pending pra
integration_issues.issue: 'Ubah' (PATCH returns 409) and 'Hapus' are shown for manager. Hapus returns 403 for manager and 200 for admin, which desyncs the SO entry. These buttons should be hidden for so_id-bound pending pra. The stale-409 banner also offers 'Coba lagi', which is pointless for a deterministic 409.

action_items: HIGH: enforce SoD in decide_approval for special_price entries. Use matrix.sod_blocked against the pra doc or requested_by_id, and return 403 when the requester decides their own entry. Then run test_sod_own_request_so_panel.
Block DELETE /price-approvals/{id} for so_id-bound docs in pending/approved status (409), or cascade to the SO entry. Hide Ubah/Hapus on SO-bound pending cards.
Set approved_by and approved_by_name (or rejected equivalents) on the pra when it is decided via decide_approval.
Show 'Ajukan Harga Khusus' to the sales_admin role in SoApprovalsPanel (or fix the 409 text that mentions Admin Sales).
Optional: mirror form attachments to the SO entry evidence; surface the friendly claim message on concurrent submit; move the alloc_sig check after the claim and wrap the claim in try/finally.
critical_code_review_comments: so_approvals.decide_approval has no SoD check, while price_approvals.approve does. There are two entry points with different policies.
price_approvals.delete_price_approval ignores _so_bound and can orphan the SO entry.
decide_approval acquires the claim without try/finally. Any exception after the claim leaves saga_lock on the SO.

success_rate.frontend: 90% (form path, supersede label, SO-panel approve, badge, and Pusat Persetujuan approve/stale all work; the sales_admin toggle is missing)
